does_not_do: It does nothing without a Beancount ledger and does not import statements itself. Its GitHub releases are a rolling nightly; versions are published to PyPI.
focus_reason: A usable view over a Beancount ledger, so its value against the need depends on adopting Beancount. 10 versions in the year; 75 open issues.
measured_against: Need: track a household's holdings and transactions across accounts over time, self-hosted, from statements or exports the owner supplies.
tests_ci: A tests/ directory; CI workflows run tests and publish.
what_it_is: A web interface for Beancount ledgers: balances, holdings, reports and queries in a browser.
